title: 2. Structural Context
use_cases: Use when architecting a multi-phase narrative generation pipeline
Implement when minimizing token usage by filtering irrelevant scene details
Configure when global story constraints like genre or ending must influence local scene generation
Use when providing a high-level plot map for Large Language Models
content:
This is the high-level view of the document. It answers the question: Where do we fit in the story arc?

- The Fix: We separate understanding the story from writing it. By analyzing all scenes first (Phase 1), we give the writer a pre-digested map of the plot, or what we call the “Big Picture”, without forcing them to read the whole raw script every time.
- The Problem: An LLM writing Scene 45 doesn’t necessarily need to know the exact dialogue from Scene 2, but it does need to know that the movie ends in a tragedy, or that the pacing should be accelerating right now.
